title: Cancellation of all ultraviolet divergences of quantum gravity by a scale-invariant gas of branes
summary: A frozen Poisson gas of branes with no preferred size, each brane a layer of independent cells that shift the proper time of a crossing graviton, multiplies the graviton kinetic operator by an entire function without zeros, $\exp[\tfrac n2\Ein(\Box^2/M^4)]$ times a random factor that tends to a constant at high momentum, in almost every realization. We prove that for $n\ge4$ the theory of gravity built on it has no ultraviolet divergence at any order of perturbation theory: every graph with two or more loops converges, the one-loop poles are those of a local theory and are cancelled by three…
